_about: HELD-OUT follow-up conversations, written and hash-frozen BEFORE the session/follow-up code existed (see followups_heldout.sha256). Author-written by the assistant, not by an independent annotator: they show whether the resolver generalises beyond the cases it was developed on, not how real users phrase things. Run ONCE for the reported number; after seeing results, any fix makes the later numbers 'not clean' (same rule as question set B).

_vocab.route: session = answered from the active procedure; standalone = treated as a new request (session untouched); clarify = a question back
_vocab.tutorials: A = 'Select both cubes. Press Ctrl+J to join them. Press Tab to enter Edit Mode. Select two vertices. Press G to move them.' (s01..s05, written text, version 2.80); B = 'Press Tab to enter Edit Mode. Select a face. Press S to scale it. Press Tab to return to Object Mode. Press Ctrl+Z to undo.' (s01..s05); T = tests/corpus/transcript_synthetic.vtt (10 steps, duration 100 s, tutorial version hint 2.80)
_vocab.expect: intent, route, kind (AnswerBundle.kind), contains / not_contains (case-insensitive, searched in clarification + questions + explanations + caveats + step goals of the answer), grounded (answer carries a source or points at a step), unmet (unmet_prerequisites non-empty), status_after {step: done|skipped|failed|pending}, current_after, active_after, verification_after {step: met|unmet|unverifiable}, not_done [steps that must NOT be done after the turn]
